notes: Sanskrit from Setutila: mula (gita_bhashya.json), Madhva's Gita Bhashya (gita_bhashya.json) and Gita Tatparya Nirnaya (gita_tatparya.json); Setutila puts each commentary block on the LAST verse of Madhva's verse group. English from the Sonde PDF (born-digital Word PDF; its own Sanskrit is in a legacy font, garbled, not used), which translates verse groups (e.g. '5 - 6 - 7.') in one piece. So groups were merged into one unit each (ref like '3/5-7'; Sanskrit mula of all member verses concatenated, bhashya and tatparya as placed by Setutila) and paired with the group's English: 313 groups built covering 652 verses; 67 other verse units have no English (verse number not found in the PDF). Tatparya coverage is uneven between sources: 57 units have an English Tatparya translation but no Setutila Tatparya Sanskrit (Setutila's gita_tatparya.json looks incomplete), and 38 have Tatparya Sanskrit but the PDF parse found no Tatparya English; in those units sanskrit and english cover different parts, so score only rows where both sides are present. sanskrit = mula + bhashya + tatparya, english = verse + bhashya + tatparya translation, mula english/bhashya english/tatparya english separate. Sanskrit-quote removal in the English is heuristic (legacy-font text detected by symbol density), so some garbled fragments may remain. The PDF contains the whole work twice; only the first copy is used. First pass. [7 units where the source has no Sanskrit commentary but english covered verse plus commentary: english is now the verse translation only and the commentary translation is kept in parts (bhashya, english only): 2/72, 10/42, 13/13, 13/24, 14/27, 15/8, 17/7] [Chapter 1 regrouped to Sonde's verse groups (1; 2-12; 13-19; 20-23; 24-46; 47), with English from the archive.org djvu text of Sonde's book (the Devanagari in that text is garbled and unused); the earlier 1/2-12 unit had the whole chapter's English. Units 3/20-26, 4/14-16, 13/31-34, 16/18-20 and 18/72-78 merge the Setutila verses that Sonde translates together with the group before them. The colophon translation that had been appended to the last unit of each chapter was removed from it; it is kept on the colophon unit only where that unit holds just the colophon (Setutila puts commentary text after some colophons).] After audit: legacy-font fragments and the Sonde publisher boilerplate were stripped from the english. Known open problems: english of 13/25-26 to 13/31-34 is offset by one verse, the tatparya english of 16/18-20 and 18/72-78 has no matching Sanskrit, and 12 colophon units that hold commentary Sanskrit have no english. After audit: chapter 13 was regrouped (13/0-12, 13/13-20, 13/21-23, 13/24-29, 13/30-34) because Sonde counts Arjuna's opening verse as verse 1, which put every group of Sonde's english one verse behind Setutila's Sanskrit; the five units are the smallest unions where both sides end on the same verse. Bhashya or Tatparya Sanskrit missing from Setutila for 49 parts was decoded from the Shivaji01 legacy font of Sonde's book (tools/gita_madhva_sanskrit.py); about 95% of characters match where both sources exist, so stray misspellings can occur in that Sanskrit. In 28 units a part had Sanskrit but no english, or english but no Sanskrit (Sonde's translation does not cover every passage Setutila has, and the reverse); the unit's pair (sanskrit, english) now holds only the parts that have both, so the english translates exactly the sanskrit. The other parts stay in 'parts', outside the scored pair. The other parts stay in 'parts', outside the scored pair. Stray source marks were removed from the Sanskrit (editorial brackets, asterisks, page headers, watermark text, OCR pipes for dandas). In 42 units a part had Sanskrit but no english, or english but no Sanskrit (Sonde's translation does not cover every passage Setutila has, and the reverse); the unit's pair (sanskrit, english) now holds only the parts that have both and whose english is between 0.3 and 3.5 times the Sanskrit in length, so the english translates the sanskrit it sits with. The other parts stay in 'parts', outside the scored pair. Words left in the legacy-font encoding in the english (tokens such as ']paiQa' or '[it') were removed.
